comparison.objective: Rest a cannulated forearm on an elevation wedge without harming the patient or IV line.
comparison.physical_skill: Support and reposition a passive articulated limb with bounded contact and line tension.
comparison.success_condition: Forearm supported and released on the wedge with safe wrist pose, forces, line routing, and two-second dwell.
comparison.reason: Force-limited patient handling and cable avoidance are unrelated to industrial granular screening.
